name: bug
description: Defect in program logic: code runs differently from its specification or intent

name: error
description: Wrong artifact or failed execution outside program logic (bad number, citation, doc, build)

name: issue
description: Gap: something required by the standard or task is missing or incomplete

name: problem
description: External obstacle blocking progress not caused by the project's own artifacts

name: dilemma
description: Trade-off between valid options requiring owner priority decision

name: conflict
description: Two requirements, sources, or rules contradict each other

name: formal-verification
description: Lean 4 proofs, multi-kernel checking, statement fidelity

name: citation-audit
description: Primary-source DOI/arXiv resolution and hallucination removal

name: frontier-update
description: Updating problem status for new mathematical breakthroughs
